rules.text: The Twice as Nice Guarantee applies only to in-store purchases and not to online purchases.
rules.quote: ALDI Twice as Nice Guarantee applies to in-store purchases only.

rules.text: Refunds or replacements for online purchases are handled by the third-party service provider fulfilling the order.
rules.quote: If you placed your order online through aldi.us or a third-party delivery such as Instacart, DoorDash or Uber Eats, your order is fulfilled and supported by the service provider.
